services.desc: We’re a small team with deep experience and a great passion for boating. Learn more about our story, and our location through our gallery. If you have an unanswered question about us, or if there is something we can assist with - we’d love to hear from you. I grew up on the marina docks in Brentwood Bay. Kicking around the Brentwood Inn and fishing at Jimmy Gilbert’s are fond memories for me. A lot has changed since then, but I was brought back to the days of my childhood when my “Championing Local Business” tour stopped in at Canoe Cove. In the 1970s the Schibili’s turned their passion into a working lifestyle when they established Sailtrend, a sailing chandlery, school and charter business, which is where they made their first connections to the Cove.
